headline: PAGASA Says Low-Pressure Area Develops Into Tropical Depression Pilandok
seoTitle: Tropical Depression Pilandok Forms August 30 | FMB News
seoDescription: PAGASA said a low-pressure area developed into Tropical Depression Pilandok on August 30 while the southwest monsoon continued to affect Luzon.
deck: Pilandok formed over the Philippine Sea while its circulation continued to reinforce monsoon rains over western Luzon.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: PAGASA announced on August 30 that the monitored low-pressure area had developed into Tropical Depression Pilandok over the Philippine Sea.
The system remained offshore, but its circulation continued to enhance the southwest monsoon affecting parts of Luzon.

sections.heading: Public-safety impact
paragraphs: The principal domestic concern was additional monsoon rainfall over already saturated areas rather than a direct mainland landfall.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Pilandok developed after several days of low-pressure-area monitoring and repeated rainfall warnings in Western and Central Luzon.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: PAGASA advised the public to monitor succeeding cyclone bulletins, rainfall warnings and marine advisories as Pilandok moved near the northern portion of the Philippine monitoring area.
